FACT_ID: sec08-R01 | anchor: A01
Zone colors split attention four ways with ten-second scans buying time, while the three-second rule converts tailgating pressure into gap management through lifting off, holding course, and merging right [A01].
Why it matters: group awareness; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F01, sec08-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec08-R02 | anchor: A02
Flank discipline means avoiding others' blind spots and refusing to pace, while own-blind-spot checks fire by shoulder glance before eight distinct maneuvers from lane changes to door openings [A02].
Why it matters: group awareness; difficulty medium; prereq sec08-R01; confusables sec08-F03, sec08-F04 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec08-R03 | anchor: A03
Rear checks mirror side checks across seven triggers, high beams trade distance against blinding with look-aside recovery, rain forces low beams, and night singles out walkers, work zones, adjustment lag, and one-light mysteries [A03].
Why it matters: group awareness-night; difficulty high; prereq sec08-R02; confusables sec08-F05, sec08-F06, sec08-F07 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec08-R04 | anchor: A04
Glare fights back with glass, shades, gaps, visors, and timing, while skids split into slippery-surface slides answered by lifting, brake-skipping, steering-in, and dry-pavement hunting [A04].
Why it matters: group conditions; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F08, sec08-F09 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec08-R05 | anchor: A92
Locked skids answer ABS type with firm, eased, or released pedals against pump-and-downshift fallbacks, while slippery roads staircase down by surface: wet shaves miles, snow halves, ice crawls at five, with shade and bridges freezing first [A92] [A84].
Why it matters: group skids; difficulty high; prereq sec08-R04; confusables sec08-F10, sec08-F11 [A92].
Source: [A92 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec08-R06 | anchor: A06
Storm blindness pairs the hundred-foot sight line with the thirty cap plus wipers, lights, defroster, and chains, hydroplaning floats into brake-free easing, and snow burial answers rocking and traction aids [A06].
Why it matters: group storms; difficulty high; prereq sec08-R05; confusables sec08-F12, sec08-F13, sec08-F14 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec08-R07 | anchor: A07
Floods stack five distinct killers behind unreadable depths with rerouting beating slow crossings and post-water brake tests mandatory, while winds slow tall rigs into firm grips without cruise [A07].
Why it matters: group storms; difficulty medium; prereq sec08-R06; confusables sec08-F15, sec08-F16 [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec08-R08 | anchor: A08
Fog forces low-beam patience inside sight distance with pull-off flashers as the escape, while traffic breaks convert patrol weaves into follower flashers, matched pacing, and no-passing discipline [A08].
Why it matters: group storms-control; difficulty medium; prereq sec08-R07; confusables sec08-F17, sec08-F18 [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec08-R09 | anchor: A09
Belt law binds riders and drivers alike with under-sixteen liability, crash physics explains the flying body and cross-seat sling, and correct wear routes straps across chest and low hips with pregnancy detours [A09].
Why it matters: group restraints; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F19, sec08-F20 [A09].
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec08-R10 | anchor: A10
Child restraints staircase by size: rear-facing infants with no front airbag exposure, back-seat boosters with six narrow front exceptions, then standard belts at eight or four-nine, with pro install checks [A10].
Why it matters: group restraints; difficulty high; prereq sec08-R09; confusables sec08-F21 [A10].
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec08-R11 | anchor: A11
Airbags demand ten-inch standoffs for all seats with dealer help for the cramped, children stay out of hot cars and solo sits under twelve-plus supervision, and the Basic Speed Law caps judgment at sixty-five and fifty-five defaults [A11].
Why it matters: group restraints-speed; difficulty high; prereq sec08-R10; confusables sec08-F22, sec08-F23, sec08-F24 [A11].
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec08-R12 | anchor: A12
Dual hazards resolve by severity with bikes getting three feet after oncoming clears, blowouts forbid panic inputs in favor of grip, hold, ease, and steer-straight, and pavement departures reenter gently without violent yanks [A12].
Why it matters: group emergencies; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec08-F25, sec08-F26, sec08-F27 [A12].
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec08-R13 | anchor: A93
Temperature extremes split gauge watching between speed-plus-AC discipline and antifreeze-plus-defrost care, freeway failures pull right with right-side exits, five-eleven calls, belted waiting, and rare abandonment, and patrols cover gas, jumps, patches, flats, reports, and tows minus privates, tips, bikes, and crashes [A93] [A86].
Why it matters: group emergencies; difficulty high; prereq sec08-R12; confusables sec08-F28, sec08-F29, sec08-F30 [A93].
Source: [A93 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec08-R14 | anchor: A14
Track entrapment splits on train presence: flashers mean instant exit with diagonal runs toward the train side plus emergency calls, silence means posted-number calls with crossing IDs first; distraction law bans handhelds with hands-free-only adults and zero-tolerance texts [A14].
Why it matters: group emergencies-distraction; difficulty high; prereq sec08-R13; confusables sec08-F31, sec08-F32, sec08-F33 [A14].
Source: [A14 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec08-R15 | anchor: A15
Phone rules pair mounted single-swipe use for adults against total minor bans except emergencies, assistance systems warn of alien reactions, and carbon monoxide pairs closed-garage bans with a six-symptom watchlist ending in exhaust checks [A15].
Why it matters: group distraction-tech; difficulty medium; prereq sec08-R14; confusables sec08-F34, sec08-F35, sec08-F36 [A15].
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0077]
